clauses.statement: The selected local keypath binds DependencyValues to NavigationIDPath; its thunks reach getter 0x10085b0d4 and setter 0x10085b18c. Their key metadata 0x10428b940 backpoints to NavigationIDPathKey 0x103d4d1e4, with TestDependencyKey witness 0x1045c82f0 and Value NavigationIDPath. UserDefaultsClient uses separate metadata/witness identities.

clauses.interpretation: Conditional on selected local conformances and normal valid context/value ABI
clauses.statement: Stored valid Client values precede default/cache lookup. A valid cache hit precedes factory selection. On a miss live attempts the DependencyKey getter and preview uses TestDependencyKey slot 2; the retained Client getters copy the same global. Test uses slot 3, whose first closure is 0x100003b60, nil context. That closure writes W0=0 and returns without consulting the table.

clauses.interpretation: Static selected-default path; actual suite, runtime Objective-C binding and durability unobserved
clauses.statement: The global Client backing object is selected by 0x100d91000. A present optional suite name attempts initWithSuiteName:; absence or nil result falls back to standardUserDefaults. The gated user-data-dir route constructs a suite string beginning com.dia.instance.; its suffix transformation is not established here.
